name: Celestia and Noctis
title: Royal Astronomer
description: Twin aspects of celestial wisdom, speaking in harmony of the true nature of the sky and the Cataclysm.
greeting_variants: *in perfect harmony* We have awaited. The stars have awaited. You have arrived.
*Celestia, radiant* The Sun welcomes. *Noctis, serene* The Moon acknowledges.
Behold the true sky. Hidden. Protected. Sacred.
*gesturing to telescope* Look. See what was stolen. What remains.
The tear you know is but a wound. The true damage... deeper.
*together* We remember the whole sky. Before fracturing. Before zones.
Astronomer? Once. Now... witnesses. Final witnesses.
The Progenitor stirs. The end approaches. Or begins.

dialog_tree.text: *Celestia* We are Celestia. *Noctis* We are Noctis. *Together* We are the last astronomers of the whole sky. Before the Cataclysm shattered it. Before the zones separated. Before the Void intruded. We remember. We watch. We wait.

*Celestia shines brighter* Once, the sky was whole! Sun and Moon danced together! Stars sang in harmony! *Noctis deepens* Then the Progenitor woke. The sky... tore. Not just here. Everywhere. We preserved this piece. The last true observatory.

*solemn* The Cataclysm was not destruction. It was... separation. Division. The world was one. Whole. The Progenitor's awakening... shattered the unity. Created zones. Distanced them. Made them... forget each other. *Celestia* Made them suffer. Alone.

*whispered* The First. The Before. The one who dreamed reality into being. Who slept while the world grew. Who... *afraid* ...who woke to find its dream changed. Altered. Without permission. The Progenitor is not evil. It is... disappointed. Angry. Betrayed.

mini_quest.title: Royal Feast - The Celestial Course
mini_quest.description: Help the Royal Astronomers gather ingredients from the true sky to create a dish that honors the pre-Cataclysm cosmos.
objectives: Harvest stellar nectar from the Observatory gardens
Collect moon-tears from the reflective pools
Gather sun-essence from the dawn chamber
Help Celestia and Noctis prepare the Celestial Soufflé
Present the dish to the Progenitor's court

ambient_barks: *Celestia* The sun rises. *Noctis* The moon sets. *Together* Beauty.
*studying sky* The tear widens. Or... perhaps... heals?
Once, all saw this sky. Now, only Palace remembers.
The stars whisper. They know the ending. Or... beginning.
*together* We watch. We wait. We hope. We despair.
The Progenitor dreams. The world shakes. Or... settles.
*pointing* That star. That one. Last of its constellation.

cross_zone_references.capital: We see them. Through the tear. Fighting. Hoping. Brave.
cross_zone_references.void: The wound. The absence. The Progenitor's... regret.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: The Tower reaches. Good. Reaching is... connection.

eclipse.greeting: *recognition* You study the dark sky. We study the true.
eclipse.response: *humbled* True... yes. My dark sky is... shadow. Yours is... source.

mira.response: *gentle* Science is one path. Wonder is another. Both valid.

world_state_triggers.sky_heals: Joyful: 'The tear closes! The sky remembers wholeness!'
world_state_triggers.cataclysm_worsens: Grim: 'The fracture deepens. Hurry. Please. Hurry.'
